name: gh-cross-border
description: Use this skill for Ghana cross-border tax in tax year 2026: residence of individuals, companies, partnerships and trusts, the withholding rates on payments to residents and non-residents, final withholding, notice of non-resident contracts, foreign tax credit, the double taxation agreements Ghana lists, repatriated branch profits, 3% and 10% withholding on realisation of assets, and the monthly DT 110 return. VAT on imports of services sits in ghana-vat. Trigger on "Ghana withholding tax", "WHT Ghana", "non-resident Ghana", "double tax treaty Ghana", "dividend withholding Ghana", "service fees to foreign company Ghana". Use it for any payment crossing the Ghana border.
